market.question: Will the highest temperature in Shenzhen be 27°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Shenzhen May 8 forecast is 84°F (~29°C) high; the question asks for exactly 27°C, which is 2°C below forecast. Average May high is ~29.5°C. A 27°C reading would require a significant cold front or persistent rainstorm — possible but unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Heavy rain or frontal passage suppressing peak temperature
